matches.quote: Sample details are missing: substrate, lateral dimensions, M_s, damping and anisotropy of the YIG film, and the distance of the film from the microstrip.
drive the k ≈ 0 mode coherently... as a weak coherent seed at the band bottom during parametric pumping. Show that the same analysis then returns a narrow phase histogram
The novelty claim does not account for prior phase-sensitive work... The BEC interpretation for perpendicularly magnetized YIG films has been explicitly challenged in the literature
It is not stated how the complex signal is "normalized" (per point, or per window), or whether the reference f(t) = e^{iω₀t} uses the measured or a fixed ω₀.
The BEC interpretation for perpendicularly magnetized YIG films has been explicitly challenged in the literature the authors cite ([31]). The manuscript does not engage with that critique.
give the calculated FVSW dispersion and band-bottom frequency for 281 mT... Mark the parametric-magnon frequency (f_p/2 = 3.9 GHz) explicitly
The Fig. 2 insets are said to be at "t₀" (text, p. 5) and "at the beginning of each frame" (caption)... Please make these consistent.
Show the circular statistics (mean resultant length or Rayleigh-test p-value over the 1000 shots) as a continuous function of time from the very first appearance of signal
Fig. 3b and Fig. 4a show coherence rising to about 0.5 at 0.6–0.85 µs, while the pump is still on... where any pump-imprinted phase would be most visible.

notes: C1 and C8 are marked 'partly': the review identifies the same pre-turn-off coherence (~0.5 while the pump is still on in Fig. 3b/4a) and asks to track phase and circular statistics continuously from signal onset and back-propagate phase, though it frames the issue around a pump-fixed phase scrambled by frequency chirp/jitter rather than residual magnons seeding coherence across turn-off. C3 is 'partly' because P21 asks for lateral sample dimensions but not how short-wavelength magnons couple to the 100 um waveguide.
